short: Bound odd cohomology by a special-value valuation

lean.name: UpperTheory.V.Odd.PsiBound
lean.plain: Bound odd cohomology by a special-value valuation
lean.note: When $\ell$ is odd and does not divide the field degree, the Sha eigenspace with complex-conjugation sign $(-1)^{e+1}$ has length bounded by the valuation of a scaled Bernoulli value. The sign reverses when the twist $e$ increases by one.
